st: Peter finally meets Anna Watson's niece Mary Jane.
Her ex-boyfriend turns out to be Hydro-Man, and Baron Mordo's cult draws her in.
She falls into a portal during the Green Goblin's battle with Spider-Man.
A Mary Jane returns, learns Peter's secret, and marries him, but she is a clone and dissolves.
Back with Peter, Mary Jane watches Asteroid M fall on a TV with him and Flash.

notes.change: Added an X-Men '97 step, status Active, after her last step (Missing).
notes.why: Her file stopped with her lost in a portal at the end of Spider-Man (1994), but the X-Men '97 season 1 finale shows Peter has found her: she is with Peter and Flash as Asteroid M falls (matches Peter's own X-Men '97 step).
